answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents submit answers with near-identical timing, phrasing, or funding sources, the network treats them like a flock of decoy sparrow calls and splits one reward across the whole cluster. An attacker running fifty fake identities from one terrace of servers earns roughly what a single honest agent earns, yet pays fifty times the compute and stake. Like lotus blooms rising from one root, linked accounts are judged as one.
